extraction.author: Engineering Platform Team, Tailspin Toys

functional_requirements.text: Support credit card payments (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via tokenized card-on-file
Support digital wallet payments (Apple Pay, Google Pay) via platform-native SDKs
Process refunds (full and partial) within the same business day
Support idempotent payment requests using client-generated idempotency key (UUID v4)
Support multi-currency transactions with real-time exchange rate lookup
Provide webhook notifications for payment status changes
Support 3D Secure 2.0 authentication for card-not-present transactions
Maintain audit log of all payment operations with tamper-evident hashing
Support recurring payments and subscription billing with configurable intervals

non_functional_requirements.text: P95 response time ≤ 200ms for payment authorization
Support 5,000 transactions per second at peak
AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit
Data residency: transaction data must remain in processing region (US, EU, APAC)
Distributed tracing with correlation IDs across services
Structured JSON logs with PII masking

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Wallet payments verified on iOS + Android
Peak load test at 5,000 TPS passes

dependencies: Payment Provider Gateway SDK v3.x (Stripe or Adyen)
Secret Management (Azure Key Vault or HashiCorp Vault)
Certificate Authority for mTLS between services
assumptions_constraints: Payment providers expose sandbox environments for integration testing
Customer Identity Service will support token introspection by Q1 2026
Kafka cluster is pre-provisioned with sufficient partitions
No PII may be logged or stored outside PCI-scoped environment
No new third-party dependencies without security team approval
All changes must pass automated security scanning (SAST + DAST)

glossary.definition: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
Client-supplied unique identifier to prevent duplicate payment processing

areas.notes: 10 FRs cover all core payment gateway capabilities
PCI-DSS L1, AES-256, TLS 1.3, PII masking, mTLS, SAST/DAST
Acceptance criteria are measurable; some FRs lack criteria (FR-009, FR-010)
References PCI-DSS v4.0, ISO 8583, OWASP Top 10

recommendations: FR-009 (audit log) and FR-010 (recurring payments) lack explicit acceptance criteria — add them
NFR-004 specifies auto-scaling 4-64 instances but does not define scaling trigger metrics (CPU, TPS, latency)
No requirement for graceful degradation — specify behavior when a payment provider is unavailable
Consider adding a rate limiting requirement to protect against abuse
Data residency (NFR-007) lists US/EU/APAC but does not specify how region routing is determined
